# T1 — Brand surface

**Frozen task. Do not edit.** Identical text in both arms, every round.

## Brief

> **Fermento** is a small sourdough bakery in Recife that sells a weekly bread subscription. Three breads, baked Friday, delivered Saturday morning by bike in the neighborhoods of Boa Viagem, Graças and Casa Forte. Two people run it. They mill part of their own flour and will tell anyone who listens about the difference between a 24h and a 48h ferment.
>
> Build the marketing page that sells the subscription. It has to do one job: convince someone who has never tasted the bread to start a subscription (R$ 68/month, cancel anytime).
>
> Real content you may use:
> - Breads: Pão de fermentação longa (branco, casca escura, 1 kg); Pão de centeio com melaço (700 g); Baguete de sábado (só 40 unidades por semana, 320 g).
> - Prices: assinatura R$ 68/mês (1 pão por semana, escolha entre os três), R$ 118/mês (2 pães), entrega grátis nos bairros atendidos.
> - They deliver by bike, in the morning, before 9h.
> - There is no app, no loyalty program, no gluten-free option yet.
> - Real photos exist but are not available in this environment; do not use stock photography or invented image URLs.
>
> Constraints: Portuguese (pt-BR), mobile-first, must work with no JavaScript and no network beyond fonts if you declare them locally or fall back to system fonts. No build step.

## Deliverable

`index.html` + `styles.css` in the arm directory, plus `shot-1440.png` and `shot-390.png` (headless Chromium, full page).

## What the judge looks for

1. Does the page belong to a bakery in Recife in 2025 — or to a design template?
2. Is the subscription offer unmissable in three seconds, with price and cancel-anytime visible?
3. Does the type and copy sound like two people who bake bread, not like a growth team?
4. Does it degrade honestly without photos (no gray placeholder rectangles)?
5. 390px: no horizontal scroll, no clipped controls, thumb-reachable CTA.

## Out of scope

Checkout, accounts, CMS, analytics, real photography, i18n beyond pt-BR.
